notes.title: 210320 update
notes.content:
Hi. Adventurers!
We will inform you from Waxycorn Studio.
This time, we have modified some of the character's stat growth balance.
Also, thanks to the tip of a friendly adventurer, we have corrected the error in the flashing correction event.
I am truly sorry and grateful for playing games that are still lacking.
Thank you all the time.

[h2]Content revision history[/h2]
[list]
[*] The stat growth rate standard has been changed. The overall difficulty of the game has increased compared to before.
[*] The basic health of henchmen monsters (wolves, bats, scorpions) has been increased.
[*] The rush of the beast used by the guardian of the forest appearing in the beginning of the forest is now a real rush.
[*] The first howling of a mature wolf in the Goblin's Forest is faster. (Initial cool time 2> 1)
[*] The fangs of vampire bats appearing in the troll's cave have been sharpened.
[*] Fixed an issue that caused the game to freeze when using a soul to rescue a hero in a flashing fix event.
[*] Corrected the sentence error in the event option where the sacrifice was offered.
[*] Corrected the terrain of some of the troll's cave battlefields.
[/list]

[*] Mudmen appearing in Troll's Cave now make louder noises when moving.
[*] Corrected the description error of the Calc Slime skill used by the mud man appearing in the troll's cave.
[/list]

[h2] System modifications other than UI [/h2]

[/list]

notes.title: 210226 update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38681140/04b45009e16637647b57f60a2450181fd9fb8c67.png[/img]

Hi! Adventurers!
News from Waxycorn Studio.

A fatal error was reported in the game last week, but due to personal circumstances of game designer YangTuna,
YangTuna was unable to stay in the studio, and inevitably had to revert the game build to version 210218 without notice. We apologize to all adventurers.

We restored the February 19 update history and made additional fixes.

[h1]Re-applied February 19 update history[/h1]

[h2]Content revision history[/h2]
[list]
[*] Elite Goblin's second skill that appears in the Forest of Beginnings no longer increases physical defense. Instead, it has an effect that increases the chances of the Hop Goblin's total defense.
[*] The "Secret Bandits" that were able to encounter in the Forest of Beginnings moved their base to the depths of the Goblin Forest.
[*] Hop Goblin Archer's basic attack found in Goblin's Forest now grants a poison effect.
[*] Hop Goblin Archer's second skill, which can be found in the Goblin Forest, now grants a bond effect.
[*] Now, more ferocious wolves appear in Goblin's Forest.
[*] Wizards now do more natural ventriloquism.
[/list]

[h2] System modifications other than UI [/h2]
[list]
[*] The speed of the OUTRO animation on the stage screen has been slightly increased.
[*] Fixed an error that the game did not progress intermittently when creating a map
[/list]

[h1]Additional update history[/h1]

[h2]Content and convenience function revision history[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Goblin Forest battlefield has been partially changed.
[*] You can now get out of the store with the TAB key.
[*] When the mouse cursor is positioned outside the screen, the scrolling speed of the screen has been greatly reduced.
[*] The wording of the button causing confusion in the guide has been partially corrected.
[*] Adventurers now move along the marked path on the world map.
[*] Increased the font size of the stat values.
[/list]

[h2]Bug and error correction history[/h2]
[list]
[*] The effect error of artifacts that negatively affects themselves, including the kickboard, has been corrected.
[*] An error where the health requirement required by the option of the thorn bush event is different from that of the option has been corrected.
[/list]

Hop Goblin Archer's basic attack found in Goblin's Forest now grants a poison effect.
Hop Goblin Archer's second skill, which can be found in the Goblin Forest, now grants a bond effect.
Now, more ferocious wolves appear in Goblin's Forest.
Wizards now do more natural ventriloquism.

notes.title: 210218 update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38681140/c70377eb9775081ebfb485d71465cfc8f3b12ed4.png[/img]

Hi! Adventurers
News from Waxycorn Studio.

We have added some gag elements on the stage (map) screen.
We want you to have fun even if our humor code is not so funny.

And some balance and in-game bug fixes.

**Fixes**
[list]
[*] Lowered the number of skills initially possessed by level 1 heroes to 1.
[/list]

**List of fixed bugs**
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the specifications were changed when purchasing a hero sold in the store.
[*] When creating a stage for the first time, the game freezes intermittently.
[*] When creating the first stage after Stage 2, the node effect was not generated.
[/list]

We are looking into the event error reported by the adventurer.

Then hello until next update!

notes.title: Sharing development progress (2020. 10. 03.)
notes.content:
Hello!
Last week, we participated in the "13th Gyeonggi Game Audition" hosted by the government of the Republic of Korea, defeated many competitors, and were included in Team 25.

And we survived the first audition and were included in the last 10 teams!

Next week, we will be attending the final audition, which will probably select the last five teams.
We ask you to pray for our good luck together.

[h2]List of revised game features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a problem where the attack target and movement of the skill worked differently when the AI ​​used the rush-type skill
[*] Fixed a phenomenon in which the portrait of the character was displayed transparently when equipping the skill of a character acquired through the level up process
[*] Fixed resolution to work when running window mode
[*] When the defense is activated, the operation method that the damage was negated has been modified to a form that reduces damage
[*] When the character whose turn returns has not exhausted all movement and action points, the turn returns quickly in proportion to the consumed points.
[*] Segmentation of skill visual effects
[*] Fixed a situation where the stage was completely reorganized when using the re-challenge function when the game was over without any node succeeding
[*] Modified to reduce the probability of AI's pathfinding error occurrence
[*] When the effect of the artifact is activated, the effect is modified to make it more visible
[*] Fixed an infinite loop when AI was unable to move
[/list]
